description: This file implements interaction with Google Cloud Vertex AI models, including SDK imports, error handling, various mode-based completion functions (sync, async, streaming), and class definitions for error handling and streaming. It serves as the core integration component for Vertex AI in the project.

classes.name: VertexAIError
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling Vertex AI related errors, capturing HTTP status code and message, with preset HTTP request/response info.

classes.name: TextStreamer
classes.description: A fake streaming iterator that yields words split from a given text, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous iteration.

methods.name: _get_client_cache_key( model: str, vertex_project: Optional[str], vertex_location: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Generates a cache key string based on model, project, and location identifiers for caching Vertex AI clients.

methods.name: _get_client_from_cache(client_cache_key: str)
methods.description: Retrieves cached Vertex AI client object using cache key.

methods.name: _set_client_in_cache(client_cache_key: str, vertex_llm_model: Any)
methods.description: Stores a Vertex AI client object in cache with specified key and TTL.

methods.name: completion( model: str, messages: list, model_response: ModelResponse, print_verbose: Callable, encoding, logging_obj, optional_params: dict, vertex_project=None, vertex_location=None, vertex_credentials=None, litellm_params=None, logger_fn=None, acompletion: bool = False, )
methods.description: Main function to handle synchronous generation requests to Vertex AI models, supporting chat, text, custom, and private modes with optional streaming.

methods.name: async_completion( llm_model, mode: str, prompt: str, model: str, messages: list, model_response: ModelResponse, request_str: str, print_verbose: Callable, logging_obj, encoding, client_options=None, instances=None, vertex_project=None, vertex_location=None, vertex_credentials=None, safety_settings=None, **optional_params, )
methods.description: Asynchronous counterpart to 'completion', supporting async calls for different Vertex AI modes, returning prepared ModelResponse.

methods.name: async_streaming( llm_model, mode: str, prompt: str, model: str, model_response: ModelResponse, messages: list, print_verbose: Callable, logging_obj, request_str: str, encoding=None, client_options=None, instances=None, vertex_project=None, vertex_location=None, vertex_credentials=None, safety_settings=None, **optional_params, )
methods.description: Supports asynchronous streaming responses from Vertex AI models, returning a stream wrapper suitable for real-time data processing.
